title: Forge JSON Error Envelope
description: The JSON document Forge writes to stdout when a command fails with --format json. Every field is additive: a future release may add new fields, but never removes or renames an existing one. The schemaVersion field is a stability marker for the envelope's shape. Authoritative for tooling that parses Forge's JSON output. Human-readable counterpart: docs/reference/output-streams.md. Decision records: ADR-018 (exit code taxonomy), ADR-019 (exit code semantics).

schemaVersion.description: Stability marker for the envelope's shape. Incremented on a breaking change (a field's meaning or type changes). A new field does not increment the version.

exitCode.description: The process exit code. Always in [0, 255]. Mirrors the value the process returns to the operating system.

error.description: The error's structured data. Mirrors the *forgeerr.Error type's observable API.

code.description: The registered error code. Always a member of the error code registry (see docs/reference/error-codes.md).

message.description: A short, user-facing description of the error. Single line, no trailing period, at most 80 bytes.

category.description: The error's category. Always one of the closed taxonomy's members.

context.description: Error-specific key-value pairs. Every code documents its own context keys in docs/reference/error-codes.md. Consumers must not depend on specific keys unless the code's documentation names them.

remediation.description: User-facing guidance for resolving the error. Absent when the error has no remediation.
